subtitle: Floating islands, an underground world, and a two-guardian fight

sections.title: The Center · exploration map
items: An expansion map with floating islands, an underground world, and deep seas. Guardians Broodmother Lysrix and Megapithecus appear together in The Center Arena.
There is no Dragon or Overseer here, or The Island's Tek Cave ascension route. The map has 11 artifacts, but its arena only needs six types.

sections.title: Terrain & biome
items: The northern volcanic island, western snow region, forests/Redwoods, and tropical islands have different travel requirements.

The floating island The Center and Underground World are separate routes; do not combine their entrances. Cliffside caves, deep-sea trenches, and underwater domes offer many base and expedition options.
The vast ocean and its depth are central to this map. Diving trips need enough air, durability, and a way up, not just a destination coordinate.

sections.title: Resources & transport
items: Suggestion: establish metal/crystal/obsidian routes and a supply point before harvesting in volcanic areas; balance farming distance against the risk of losing your mount.
Pearls/oil and ocean trips need dedicated transport/combat tames. Maintain materials for SCUBA repairs, ammo, and food before entering deep trenches.

sections.title: Dino theo The Center
items: Shastasaurus is a signature map creature. The registry includes Pyromane, Dreadmare, Drakelings, Elderclaw, and DLC entries marked in Dino.
Do not automatically add The Island's Unicorn or Polar Bear to Center. Dino loads only the Center registry and identified additional Alphas, not Ragnarok's list.
Registry additions include Cerberax, Gargantar, and Cryolophosaurus; read the DLC/settings requirements and check actual spawns in your save.

sections.title: 11 artifacts · 9 exploration routes
items: North Ice: Clever/Devourer; South Ice: Skylord; Lava Oasis: Hunter; Lava Cave: Massive/Strong.
Jungle: Immune; Cliffside: Cunning; floating island The Center Cave: Devious; Underground World: Pack; southeastern ocean trench: Brute.
The arena set is Brute, Clever, Devourer, Hunter, Massive, and Pack. Other artifacts still have GPS profiles; you do not need to farm all 11 to summon the Center fight.

sections.title: The Center Arena double-boss fight
items: Gamma/Beta/Alpha require level 70/80/90 and the same six artifacts; Beta/Alpha have separate apex tributes. Both bosses share one fight, not two independent portals.
Defeat both bosses to complete the fight and receive rewards.
A team may use Rex/Theri and Yutyrannus, with Megatherium considered for spider minions. This is tactical guidance; saddles, imprinting, settings, and the timer determine whether it can succeed.

sections.title: Base suggestions · The Center
items: Start on a surveyed coast/island with water, materials, and access routes. Avoid prioritizing the floating island's scenery before solving transport.
A long-term base needs access to farming regions and the sea. Underworld / domes have distinct entrances and building conditions; survey them before moving all your storage down.
Separate ocean tame docks, breeding, crafting, and cave supplies. Record the entrance used so later trips do not confuse it with artifact coordinates.

sections.title: Suggested progression · The Center
items: Phase 1–2: survival, base, and harvesting/transport tames. Phase 3: cave kits, lighting, cold/heat protection, and ocean tames.
Phase 4: collect the six arena artifacts and apex tributes for the chosen difficulty; breed/imprint the boss team and prepare saddles. Other artifacts are exploration/library-completion goals.

Phase 5: The Center Arena Gamma → Beta → Alpha as preparation allows; collect actual loot and improve the team. For The Island ascension, select that map and follow its separate guardian/Tek Cave route.

sections.title: Single Player · platform for correct calculation
items: Record Difficulty, Maximum Difficulty, Use Singleplayer Settings, taming/breeding rates, resource respawn, and all mods before planning. These are input conditions; another server's stats are not the standard for your save.

Suggestion: keep settings stable, record after each change. The goal of a phase should be specific completion conditions: enough machines, enough equipment, enough tame and the exit route has been surveyed.
Creature levels and locations may change according to world and mod settings.

sections.title: Read maps & coordinates
items: LAT increases southward and LON eastward. Artifact marks the collection point; cave entrance marks the approach. Nearby points have a selection menu; use the Artifact / Cave entrance / Boss layers separately.
Cave entrance coordinates are community guidance and may vary with version or standing position. Area/reference points are not exact entrances. The 8K map shows terrain, not cave floors.
